def transform(grid):
    """Copy the rare foreground object's shape into every all-zero placement."""
    if not grid or not grid[0]:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    if not counts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
    min_r = min(r for r, _ in points)
    min_c = min(c for _, c in points)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points]
    height = max(r for r, _ in shape) + 1
    width = max(c for _, c in shape) + 1
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(rows - height + 1):
        for left in range(cols - width + 1):
            cells = [(top + r, left + c) for r, c in shape]
